title: FYLO collection descriptor in a namespace catalog (DRAFT, ADR 0033, not yet built)
description: Describes <drive>/<app>/<namespace>/.fylo/catalog/<collection>.json. One file per collection, so creating one collection never rewrites another's descriptor.

storage.description: files: one <TTID>.json or <TTID>.<ext> per entry. segments: ADR 0015 segment files under <collection>/.fylo/segments/.

shardWidth.description: 0 while the collection is flat (up to the flat limit, 10,000 entries by default); then 1, then 2 (ADR 0033 section 8). Never lowered automatically.

resharding.description: Present only while an automatic or manual reshard runs. Lookups try the new width, then the old one.
